conditions: User is on the shop homepage with EN language active
User clicks the Language selection menu button
User selects German (DE) from the language menu
items.expected: The language menu closes and the language indicator shows 'DE'; the shop's UI labels (e.g., navigation and product section labels) appear in German

conditions: User has selected German (DE) as the language
items.expected: The language indicator still shows 'DE' after reload; the shop's UI labels remain in German and are not reset to English

conditions: User is on the shop homepage with EN language active
User selects German (DE) from the language menu
items.expected: The language menu closes and 'DE' is shown in the language indicator; the HTML document's lang attribute changes to the German language code (e.g., 'de') and no longer reads 'en'

conditions: User is on the shop homepage
axe-core scans the top navigation bar (language switcher area) with WCAG 2.x A and AA rules
items.expected: No axe-core violations are reported (violations.map(v => v.id).sort() equals [])

excluded.reason: SCRUM-28 is about order tracking showing any order to unauthenticated users — it touches SCRUM-27 (order history), not this story's language-switching behaviour
SCRUM-12 is about session token surviving logout — it touches authentication/session behaviour, not this story's language-switching behaviour
Neither open bug (SCRUM-28, SCRUM-12) touches this story's language-switching behaviour, so no confirmation test is needed here
The language-switching feature carries no security surface: it stores only a UI preference (language code) with no authentication, authorisation, or sensitive data involved
